node.label: Arctic & Greenland
node.summary: Greenland, Arctic security and great-power competition in the High North.

facts.text: Greenland is an autonomous part of the Kingdom of **Denmark** under the **2009 Self-Government Act**; Denmark keeps foreign, defence and security policy. Greenland PM: **Jens-Frederik Nielsen**; capital **Nuuk**.
facts.plain: Greenland is an autonomous part of the Kingdom of Denmark under the 2009 Self-Government Act; Denmark keeps foreign, defence and security policy. Greenland PM: Jens-Frederik Nielsen; capital Nuuk.

facts.text: **US-Denmark-Greenland** security agreement (signed at the UN, **22 Sept 2026**) expands US military presence while reaffirming Danish sovereignty: expansion of **Pituffik Space Base**, new facilities at **Narsarsuaq** and **Mestersvig**, cooperation on the **Golden Dome** missile shield, and curbs on non-NATO/EU investment. It has no expiry date.
